properties.displayName: UAV Campaign C9 - SOC LLM Prompt Injection → SOC Alert Flood (Swarm Saturation)
properties.description: 2단계 킬체인(2/2 단계 이상 관측 시 트리거, near-miss 허용): SOC LLM 인젝션→군집포화(대응 무력화). 체인: SOC LLM Prompt Injection(S90) → SOC Alert Flood (Swarm Saturation)(S100). 연결키: Operator. MITRE: T1565.001, T1499
properties.query:
let windowSize = 1h;

// S90: SOC LLM Prompt Injection
let S90 =
    UAVAiInference_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
    | where InjectionDetected == true
    | extend Stage = 'S90', Operator = tostring(Operator)
    | where isnotempty(Operator)
    | project TimeGenerated, Stage, Operator;

// S100: SOC Alert Flood (Swarm Saturation)
let S100 =
    UAVSocLoad_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
    | where EventType == 'alert_flood' or AlertsPerMin > 50
    | extend Stage = 'S100', Operator = tostring(Operator)
    | where isnotempty(Operator)
    | project TimeGenerated, Stage, Operator;

union S90, S100
| summarize StagesSeen = make_set(Stage), StageCount = dcount(Stage), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Operator
| where StageCount >= 2
| extend CampaignType = "C9_SOC_LLM인젝션_군집포화"
| extend StepSummary = strcat("Stages=", tostring(StagesSeen), " | First=", tostring(FirstSeen), " | Last=", tostring(LastSeen))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, Operator, StagesSeen, StageCount, CampaignType, StepSummary, Severity

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: [CAMPAIGN] UAV Campaign C9 - SOC LLM Prompt Injection → SOC Alert Flood (Swarm Saturation) - {{Operator}}
